children: Lovesac Co reported results for the 13-week period ended Aug 2, 2026, with revenue roughly flat at $161.2M versus $160.5M a year earlier and a return to profitability as net income rose to $7.4M and diluted EPS reached $0.51 compared with a loss and negative EPS in the prior-year quarter.
Revenue: $161.2M for the 13‑week period ended Aug 2, 2026, vs $160.5M year‑ago quarter (0.4% YoY).
Net income: $7.4M for the 13‑week period ended Aug 2, 2026, vs $(6.7)M year‑ago quarter (turnaround YoY).
Diluted EPS: $0.51 for the 13‑week period ended Aug 2, 2026, vs $(0.45) in the year‑ago quarter.

Revenue and profitability momentum: Net sales were essentially flat year over year while gross margin expanded to 68.4%, driven by recognized tariff refunds and product price gains that helped produce quarterly net income versus a prior-year loss.
Channel shift and footprint: Showroom footprint grew to 284 locations; showroom sales strengthened while Best Buy shop‑in‑shops were closed, reducing sales classified in the "Other" channel.
Product and innovation: Company launched the Snugg platform, AnyTable, Sactionals Reclining Seat, StealthTech Charge Side and PillowSac Chair Jr., broadening its modular and premium offerings.

Operational efficiency and supply chain: Tariff refund recognition lifted margins and the company is pursuing phased domestic manufacturing to improve reliability and reduce logistics and tariff risk.
